faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: The most important things about subscription and setup
faq.q1: How do I start using VPN quickly?
faq.a1: Purchase a plan in the Plans section, then open Configs and connect your app using the setup instructions. It usually takes 1-2 minutes.
faq.q2: Where can I find my subscription link?
faq.a2: Open the Configs section and tap Copy link. You can paste this link into any supported app.
faq.a3: Check that your subscription is active, not expired, and that your app has the latest profile. If needed, refresh config and restart the app.
faq.q4: Can I use it on multiple devices?
faq.a4: Yes. The number of available connections depends on your plan. You can manage connected devices from the devices block on the Home page.
faq.q5: What if payment succeeded but subscription was not activated?
faq.a5: Reopen the app and wait a few seconds. If status is still unchanged, contact support and include your profile ID and payment time.
faq.q6: How do I change the interface language?
faq.a6: Go to Profile and tap Language. In the popup window, choose the language you need.
